info.description: Generated from Spring MVC controllers in certi-master. Set baseUrl and accessToken before testing protected endpoints.

query.description: Optional. Enable this query parameter to return domains for a single certification.

request.description: Public endpoint returning centralized constants and catalog options for frontend combo boxes.
Public login endpoint. Test script stores accessToken and refreshToken when present.
Build OAuth authorization URL for google/github.
Provider callback endpoint. Usually called by Google/GitHub and redirects to frontend.
Uses refresh cookie or JSON body refreshToken.
Multipart form-data. Choose a local image file in Postman.
